Name: Bosch MRF23EVS

T27139 Laminate Trim Router with Plunge Base

The T27139 Laminate Trim Router is powered by a 1 HP, 6.5A motor with a no-load speed of 10,000–30,000 RPM.

It features an adjustable plunge depth with 3-step turret and a 1/4" collet size.

Includes micro-adjustable guide bearing, fence, fixed base, and collet wrench. Weighs 7 lbs.

Made in an ISO 9001 factory

Like all Grizzly machines, the T27139 comes with a 1-year warranty which covers parts and assures the unit is free from factory defects. (Consumables are not covered by the warranty.)

The T27139 manual was written by our U.S. based Technical Documentation Department and is packed with useful information.

The Grizzly Customer Service and Technical Support Teams are U.S. based.

Parts and accessories for the trim router are available online and shipped from the Grizzly parts warehouse in Springfield, MO.
